0022600121.text: The Celtics (1-1, 1-0 at home, third in the Atlantic and eighth in the East) host the Chicago Bulls (1-2, on a one-game losing streak, fourth in the Central and 11th in the East). Boston is without Devin Carter, who is out with illness, while Chicago is missing Nic Claxton, who is out with a hamstring injury, and Noa Essengue and Patrick Williams, who are both day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions with a head bruise and groin soreness, respectively. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Boston won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 124-105 home win on February 11, 2026.
